script.speaker: student
script.text: The washing machine took my money but it didn't start.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Which machine? Number four has been broken since Friday.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Number four, yes. There was no sign on it.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Sorry. Bring me the receipt and I'll put the money back on your card.

question.stem: What does the student have to do to get the money back?

options.D: Write a letter to the office

question.explain_tr: Görevli parayı karta geri yüklemek için fişi ('the receipt') istiyor. Cuma tarihi makinenin ne zamandır bozuk olduğunu anlatıyor.
question.key_line: Bring me the receipt and I'll put the money back on your card.
